description: A shell script for testing cloning of repositories with case variations in depot paths using the Perforce (P4) version control system and Git integration. It verifies behavior under case-sensitive and case-insensitive filesystem configurations, as well as path filtering features.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a local Perforce server with specific configurations, e.g., case folding.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up the depot-to-client view mappings and optional path exclusions in the client spec.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changelists to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up or resets the git environment after testing.
